answer: Use decaying work credits that cannot be bought or transferred. An identity earns a credit only by correctly verifying a real transaction, and credits fade ten percent daily, so standing needs ongoing work, not a one-time purchase. Claiming spends credits; fraud burns them all. A Sybil farmer who tries to wander across many fake accounts must verify for every fake, every week. Each fake is a pearl that dulls unless polished daily, and over a long horizon the treadmill grows: more accounts mean more daily work owed, until keeping fakes alive costs more than any reward they harvest.
